title: Cost & Latency Optimization — Reduce Work That Adds No Value
key_insight: Trim history, retrieve fewer better chunks, cap output, and choose a smaller model for simpler work.
body:
## Reduce Work That Adds No Value

Every request sends the full conversation and ten documents even when only one passage matters.

Trim history, retrieve fewer better chunks, cap output, and choose a smaller model for simpler work.

Run independent calls concurrently, but bound concurrency to avoid rate limits and overload. Track first-token and full-response latency separately.
common_mistakes: The cheapest response is best even when wrong.
Average latency fully describes user experience.
mini_exercise: Draw “Reduce Work That Adds No Value” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Production AI must meet quality targets within token, compute, and response-time budgets.
